title: Does the Voice Matter? Evaluating Frustration Detection on Deployed Clinical Voice-Agent Calls
abstract: arXiv:2611.21001v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Autonomous voice agents now conduct routine clinical follow-up calls, so some automated triage is unavoidable. A patient becoming frustrated is one thing that triage should catch. These systems typically read only the transcript the speech-to-text stage produces, not the voice, and whether that is enough is largely untested on real clinical speech. We study per-turn frustration detection on real patient calls from a deployed clinical voice agent: 150 turns from six calls labelled by three annotators, with a length-matched acted corpus as a control, and 714 turns from 30 calls. Patient turns are overwhelmingly short: across the deployed calls, roughly 59% are one or two words, against 13% in the full acted corpus, and a corpus accuracy gap remains even after the acted set is length-matched. translated_title: 声音是否重要？在已部署的临床语音代理通话中评估挫败感检测
translated_abstract: 自主语音代理如今已能进行常规的临床随访电话，因此某种自动化的分诊不可避免，而患者产生挫败感正是分诊应当捕捉的情况之一。这些系统通常只读取语音转文字阶段生成的文本转录，而不使用语音本身，这种做法是否足够，很大程度上尚未在真实临床语音上得到验证。我们在一个已部署的临床语音代理的真实患者通话中研究了逐轮次的挫败感检测：来自六个通话的150个轮次由三名标注者进行标注，并以长度匹配的表演语料库作为对照，另外还有来自30个通话的714个轮次。患者的通话轮次绝大多数非常简短：在已部署通话中，约59%的轮次仅为一两个词，而表演语料库中这一比例仅为13%；即使将表演语料库进行长度匹配，两个语料库之间的准确率差距依然存在。在单词轮次上，仅基于文本转录的检测结果无法排除随机猜测的可能性。在五个具备音频处理能力的语言模型中，转录文本仅标记出……中的3或4个（摘要原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 在真实临床语音代理通话中，患者话语极短（约59%仅一两个词），仅依赖文本转录无法可靠检测患者的挫败情绪，语音音频信息是必要的。
en_tdlr: On real clinical voice-agent calls, patient turns are overwhelmingly short (≈59% are just one or two words), and transcript-only frustration detection performs at chance level on one-word turns, showing that voice audio is essential for reliable frustration detection.
